id: 14_What are the 8 general lab safety rules
title: 实验室八条通用安全规则（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/14_What are the 8 general lab safety rules.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/14_What are the 8 general lab safety rules（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 规则挡住的是暴露途径
points.K3: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装
points.K5: 规则四：用合适的容器存放
points.K6: 规则五：给工作区做好标识
points.S1: 培养箱、试剂冰箱不放食物
points.S2: 手上有伤口，先包好再进
points.S3: 无人值守的实验：挂牌留电话

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身旁漂浮着八个编号气泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab door with eight numbered bubbles floating beside it.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。
overlay: 实验室八条通用安全规则

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指数数
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers with a cheerful expression.
shots.narration: 今天记住八条最基本的规则。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着面包和奶茶走进实验室，小研皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a microbiology lab holding a bread roll and a cup of milk tea; the female graduate student frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰拎着早饭就进了实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着短裤拖鞋，小研指了指他的脚
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the young male student's shorts and open sandals.
shots.narration: 短裤、拖鞋，一样也没对。

shots.scene: 小研把阿杰带回门外，指着门口的规则板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student back outside and points at a blank rules board with eight icons.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把八条规则过一遍。

shots.section_title: 规则挡住的是暴露途径
shots.scene: 人形图标周围四个箭头：口、鼻、皮肤眼睛、针
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with four arrows pointing to the mouth, the nose, the skin and eyes, and a needle at the hand. No people.
shots.narration: 有害物进入人体，主要有四条路。
overlay: 规则挡住的是暴露途径

shots.section_title: 规则挡住的是暴露途径
shots.scene: 四个箭头被一面面盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Each of the four arrows is blocked by a small shield. No people.
shots.narration: 八条规则，就是把这些路一一堵上。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯、零食打叉
shots.prompt_en: A water bottle and a snack on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第一条，实验室里不吃不喝。

shots.scene: 手套上的微点沾到面包上
shots.prompt_en: Tiny dots on a gloved hand transfer onto a piece of bread, shown as a diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 手上、台面上的污染，会跟着进嘴。

shots.scene: 嚼口香糖、咬笔头的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of chewing gum and biting a pen, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 口香糖、咬笔头，也算。

shots.scene: 阿杰把早饭放进门外休息区的柜子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his breakfast into a locker in the rest area outside the lab.
shots.narration: 吃喝去休息区，洗手后再吃。

shots.section_title: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装
shots.scene: 阿杰穿上长袖实验服，扣好扣子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a long-sleeved lab coat and buttons it up.
shots.narration: 第二条，穿好防护和实验着装。
overlay: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装

shots.section_title: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装
shots.scene: 实验服、手套、护目镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a lab coat, a pair of gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套、护目镜按要求戴，

shots.section_title: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装
shots.scene: 长裤和不露脚面的鞋，旁边拖鞋短裤打叉
shots.prompt_en: Long trousers and closed-toe shoes with a green check; shorts and sandals crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿长裤和不露脚的鞋，

shots.section_title: 规则二：穿好防护和实验着装
shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back before entering the lab.
shots.narration: 长发扎起来，首饰摘下来。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水池前用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 第三条，讲究个人卫生。

shots.scene: 摘手套后洗手、离开前洗手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: removing gloves then washing hands, and washing hands before walking out a door. No people.
shots.narration: 摘手套后、离开前，都要洗手。

shots.scene: 戴手套摸脸、揉眼、摸手机的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gloved hand touching the face, rubbing an eye and touching a phone, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，不摸脸、不揉眼、不碰手机。

shots.scene: 化妆品和隐形眼镜盒打叉
shots.prompt_en: A makeup kit and a contact lens case on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在实验室里化妆、摘戴隐形眼镜。

shots.section_title: 规则四：用合适的容器存放
shots.scene: 密封盖好的试剂瓶和样品盒整齐摆在架上
shots.prompt_en: Tightly capped reagent bottles and a sealed sample box arranged neatly on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 第四条，用合适的容器存放。
overlay: 规则四：用合适的容器存放

shots.section_title: 规则四：用合适的容器存放
shots.scene: 饮料瓶装试剂、敞口烧杯的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a drink bottle filled with a reagent and an uncovered beaker, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用饮料瓶装试剂，不敞口放置。

shots.section_title: 规则四：用合适的容器存放
shots.scene: 试剂瓶放进托盘里，托盘接住了漏出的液滴
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle stands in a plastic tray that catches a small drip. No people.
shots.narration: 容器要耐受、密封，下面放托盘。

shots.section_title: 规则四：用合适的容器存放
shots.scene: 小研把样品管放进有盖的密封盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places sample tubes into a lidded leak-proof box with a biohazard sign.
shots.narration: 生物样品，放进密封、防漏的盒子。

shots.section_title: 规则五：给工作区做好标识
shots.scene: 试剂瓶标签上只有象形图和空白格子
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label showing only a hazard pictogram and empty lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第五条，给工作区做好标识。
overlay: 规则五：给工作区做好标识

shots.section_title: 规则五：给工作区做好标识
shots.scene: 小研在样品管上贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks blank labels onto sample tubes and a culture dish.
shots.narration: 容器写清是什么、谁的、哪天的，

shots.section_title: 规则五：给工作区做好标识
shots.scene: 工作台角落立着生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard sign placed at the corner of a work bench where cultures are handled. No people.
shots.narration: 有危害的区域，摆好警示标志。

shots.section_title: 规则五：给工作区做好标识
shots.scene: 没有标签的瓶子上方问号，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled bottle with a big question mark above it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有标签的东西，别人不敢碰也不敢扔。

shots.scene: 空荡荡的夜间实验室，只有阿杰一人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An empty lab at night with only the young male student working alone, the scene crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 第六条，不独自工作。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在同一间实验室各自做实验
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work at separate benches in the same lab.
shots.narration: 身边有人，出事才有人帮你。

shots.scene: 老周在空白值班表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank lab schedule sheet on the door.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按规定至少两人在场。

shots.scene: 阿杰一边操作一边看手机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at his phone while pipetting, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 第七条，专心，留意周围。

shots.scene: 阿杰收起手机，专注地操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his phone away and focuses on his work at the bench.
shots.narration: 做实验时不玩手机，不打闹。

shots.scene: 小研端着培养皿经过，阿杰侧身让路
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a tray of culture dishes past; the young male student steps aside to let her through.
shots.narration: 看看周围有谁、在做什么，

shots.scene: 地上一根电线被阿杰发现，他指给小研看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a cable lying across the floor and points it out to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，马上说出来。

shots.scene: 王老师带学生们在走廊参加疏散演练
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads students along a corridor toward an exit sign during an evacuation drill.
shots.narration: 第八条，参加安全演练。

shots.scene: 阿杰在演练中找到洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: During the drill, the young male student points to an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 演练时记住洗眼器、灭火器在哪，

shots.scene: 小研示范溢洒应急箱的位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows where the spill kit box with a blank label is kept.
shots.narration: 溢洒、割伤、着火，各怎么处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起电话，旁边王老师和老周的图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a phone, with icons of the safety administrator and the older man beside it.
shots.narration: 出了事，先处置，再报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 培养箱、试剂冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 培养箱里放着饭盒，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An incubator with a lunch box inside next to culture plates, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 规则一还要延伸一步。
overlay: 培养箱、试剂冰箱不放食物

shots.section_title: 培养箱、试剂冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 试剂冰箱门上贴生物危害标志，旁边另一台休息区冰箱
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator with a biohazard sign on its door, and a separate fridge in the rest area outside. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂冰箱、培养箱，不放食物饮料。

shots.section_title: 培养箱、试剂冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 微波炉加热饭菜的图标在实验室内打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a microwave heating food inside a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室微波炉，也不热饭。

shots.section_title: 手上有伤口，先包好再进
shots.scene: 阿杰手指上有一道小伤口
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the young male student's finger with a small cut.
shots.narration: 手上有伤口，最容易被感染。
overlay: 手上有伤口，先包好再进

shots.section_title: 手上有伤口，先包好再进
shots.scene: 小研给阿杰贴好防水创可贴，再戴双层手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student cover the cut with a waterproof bandage, then he puts on two pairs of gloves.
shots.narration: 先用防水敷料包好，再戴手套，

shots.section_title: 手上有伤口，先包好再进
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周说明情况，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tells the older man about his cut; the older man nods and points to a lower-risk task.
shots.narration: 告诉负责人，必要时换个活儿。

shots.section_title: 无人值守的实验：挂牌留电话
shots.scene: 摇床在夜里运行，门上挂着空白告示牌
shots.prompt_en: A shaker runs overnight in a dark lab; a blank notice card with a phone icon hangs on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 规则五还能用在过夜实验上。
overlay: 无人值守的实验：挂牌留电话

shots.section_title: 无人值守的实验：挂牌留电话
shots.scene: 小研在告示牌上填写，图示：内容、时间、电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank notice card on the shaker.
shots.narration: 写明在做什么、到几点、怎么联系。

shots.section_title: 无人值守的实验：挂牌留电话
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员巡楼时看到告示牌，点头
shots.prompt_en: The security officer on a night patrol reads the notice card on the door and nods.
shots.narration: 出了状况，别人能马上找到你。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁八个图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside eight icons in two rows: no food, lab coat, hand washing, sealed bottle, label, two people, focused eye, drill.
shots.narration: 不吃喝、穿防护、讲卫生、存放好，

shots.scene: 后四个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last four icons glow: a label, two people, a focused eye, and an evacuation drill. No people.
shots.narration: 做标识、不独处、要专心、勤演练。

shots.scene: 阿杰换好实验服、长裤和合适的鞋，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, now in a lab coat, long trousers and closed-toe shoes, gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：八条规则，天天都用得上。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 守好规则，安心做实验，下次见！
